thread:
julie_support: @dan heads-up — customer BrightMap (acct: brightmap-prod) reports objects still visible after TTL expired and their DELETE call returned 500. They requested immediate preservation for legal review. attaching repro steps.

julie_support: Repro steps:
1) curl -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/obj-xyz?account=brightmap-prod" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
2) Response: 500

julie_support: Curl output:
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"internal_error","message":"storage.delete failed: KMS AccessDenied"}
```

julie_support: They also did a GET after TTL and the object still returns 200 with metadata: tombstone:false, deleted_at:null

dan_engineering: Can you paste the request-id from the 500 and which KMS key they're on? Need those to check decrypt traces.

julie_support: request-id: req_0a1b2c3d; customer key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01

chris_sre: I'll check the storage-delete pipeline. 500 + KMS AccessDenied usually means a key policy or role perm changed, or a CMK rotation. priya, can you pull KMS/HSM logs for that key around 2026-03-15T18:22Z?

priya_security: Pulling logs now. I see a Deny on Encrypt/Decrypt for principal redwood-service-role at 2026-03-15T18:22:34Z. There's an automated CMK rotation job recorded at 18:20Z. Escalating to infra on-call.

auditbot: Note: created incident #INC-20260315-42 (severity: high) — linked to legal hold request. Audit trail preserved.

erin_legal: We need a formal preserve request from the customer before we extend any retention outside SLA. Julie — ask them to send a written preservation notice to legal@redwood.ai.

julie_support: Customer replied: "Please pause deletes for acct brightmap-prod for legal review — email sent from legal@brightmap.com". Forwarded to erin_legal.

dan_engineering: Immediate mitigation plan: (1) disable async deletion worker for that account, (2) route incoming DELETEs for the account to return 423 Locked until we confirm KMS policy. I can patch the fallback if SRE toggles the account flag.

chris_sre: Toggled account=brightmap-prod: delete_enabled=false at 2026-03-15T18:30Z. Confirmed no delete ops are being dequeued for that account. Retention background tasks paused.

priya_security: KMS policy rollback scheduled to revert the rotation at 2026-03-15T18:45Z pending approvals. Will post verification logs when complete.

dan_engineering: Also capturing tombstone index state. If objects remain searchable despite tombstone=true, that's an index lag — scheduling a reindex job.

julie_support: Customer confirms they can see objects via search UI and API. They want timeline for full purge and assurance that nothing will be removed while legal reviews.

erin_legal: Once we have the customer's formal preservation email and incident doc, legal hold will be applied. No purges or exports until legal signs off.

chris_sre: Action items summary:
- priya: complete KMS rollback and confirm Decrypt allowed (post logs)
- dan: audit delete pipeline and prepare requeue for failed deletes
- julie: collect customer's formal preservation email and account contacts

priya_security: KMS rollback completed at 2026-03-15T18:44:50Z. Verified Decrypt allowed for redwood-service-role. Sample log entry: "Decrypt OK req=req_0a1b2c3d"

dan_engineering: Re-ran delete for req_0a1b2c3d in a safe staging path; returned 200 and tombstone set correctly. In prod we'll only reattempt after legal confirms they do not want active preservation. For now deletes remain locked.

julie_support: Updating customer: we've paused deletes for their account, KMS access issue fixed, and legal hold options are next steps. I'll update on timeline once legal confirms.

erin_legal: Legal hold filed: LH-2026-03-BRIGHTMAP. Hold effective immediately until 2026-04-15 or further notice.

julie_support: Sent update to customer at 18:52Z. They requested an audit export (list of deletion attempts + key usage). Assigned to priya for secure export.

priya_security: Exported audit bundle to secure share: s3://redwood-legal-exports/brightmap-20260315.tar.gz (CMK masked). Shared link with erin_legal and julie_support over encrypted channel.

julie_support: Thanks everyone. From support POV this is resolved — will reopen if legal or customer asks for additional actions.
